text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed our 'hello-slim' quickstart still uses the old AUTH_TOKEN flow (mentions env var REDWOOD_API_TOKEN and inline bearer examples) that's been superseded by SDK v6 patterns. We should refresh the tutorial + code snippets and fix a couple broken links. Planning a small PR to replace token examples with the `REDWOOD_API_KEY` env var + `client = RedwoodClient.fromEnv()` pattern. Who can review?

sam: I can take the Python snippets. Quick Q: are we standardizing on `REDWOOD_API_KEY` or `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` in examples? SDK team said `REDWOOD_API_KEY` is preferred for clarity.

jordan: Saw this earlier — internal migration doc also prefers `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. I'll own the Node/TS examples and the function-calling snippet.

ben: I'll open a PR to update README and the quickstart markdown, add stubs for the snippets. Please drop your changes into my branch so CI runs. Aim to land before Friday's docs deploy.

maria: thx. Sam — also add a short note about the new `client.with_session()` helper introduced in v6.1 so users don't try to reimplement token rotation. Example would be helpful.

sam: added a Python snippet to my local patch, posting here for review:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os

client = RedwoodClient.from_env()  # reads REDWOOD_API_KEY
with client.with_session() as sess:
    resp = sess.chat.generate("Hello from hello-slim")
    print(resp.text)
```

jordan: Node/TS snippet suggestion (I'll PR this):
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood'
const client = RedwoodClient.fromEnv()
const resp = await client.chat.generate({ input: 'hi' })
console.log(resp.output)
```

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 by ben — includes initial snippet swaps and README edits. CI status: linkcheck failing (1 broken link).

sam: linkcheck failure: quickstart points to `github.com/redwood/starterapp` which moved to `github.com/redwood/hello-starter`. I'll update links + add redirect note. Also fixed a mismatched anchor on the deploy section.

jordan: deployment note — `gcloud` example uses a hardcoded `--project old-project` value. I'll change to `--project ${PROJECT_ID}` and add a short blurb about service account roles (roles/run.admin + roles/iam.serviceAccountUser).

ben: pinging @katie for UX/reviewer — can you do a quick pass on images and accessibility? One of the screenshots got removed in the repo move and CI flagged it.

katie: on it. I'll add alt text, swap the missing screenshot for a compressed one, and push a tiny layout tweak. Also recommend moving the auth config earlier in the doc so users don't deploy then discover missing env vars.

maria: small suggestion to include a smoke test after the deploy so users can verify tokens quickly: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://hello.example/api/ping` — maybe include a `requests` Python example too.

sam: added that curl + requests snippet to the PR and fixed the README anchors. Also verified the `REDWOOD_API_KEY` name is consistent across snippets.

docs-bot: CI passed on latest commit (linkcheck + lint). Merge scheduled for 12:00 UTC.

ben: merging now. Release note for changelog: "quickstart: refresh hello-slim auth + deploy examples, update links and add smoke test" :tada:

maria: awesome — thanks everyone. Follow-up: I'll open a micro-PR to add a small migration note for v5 -> v6 auth changes (what to change in existing starter apps). Will tag SDK authors for review.

sam: sounds good — lmk if you want me to draft the migration checklist.

maria: I'll draft and assign. Closing this thread once migration PR is up.
